tutorial.lead3d: You hold 3♦, so you start. Tap the 3♦ (you can add cards that make a pair, triple or 5-card hand), then tap Play.
tutorial.beatIt: Someone played. Beat it with the same number of cards but higher, or tap Pass.
tutorial.freeLead: Everyone passed, so you lead! Play anything: a single, pair, triple or 5-card hand.
tutorial.order: Order: 3 is lowest, then up to K, A, and 2 is highest. Suits: ♦ < ♣ < ♥ < ♠.
tutorial.goal: Empty your hand first. Everyone else takes a point for each card left.

bigtwo: Get rid of all your cards first.
Ranks: 3 lowest, then 4 to K, A, and 2 highest. Suits: ♦ < ♣ < ♥ < ♠.
Whoever holds 3♦ starts, and the first play must include it.
Play a single, pair, triple or a 5-card hand. You must play the same number of cards as the last play, and beat it.
5-card hands, low to high: straight, flush, full house, four of a kind + 1, straight flush.
A straight is 5 in a row from 3 up to 2 (J-Q-K-A-2 is the highest). No wrapping.
A better suit wins between flushes; within a suit, the highest card wins.
When everyone else passes, the last player to play leads anything.
Standard: the round ends when someone goes out. Others score a point per card left; 10 to 12 cards count double, 13 triple.
Fight Till The End: play on until one player still holds cards. 1st scores 0, each later place +1, and last also adds cards left.
